fixed.summary: FSR 3.1 keeps thin static geometry (poles, wires, fences) as dark and sharp as a supersampled frame: where its history is whole it accumulates with an upsample kernel half as wide as AMD's, easing back to AMD's while the camera or the scene moves. Against a 4-samples-a-pixel ground truth thin static geometry is 1.1 to 1.8 dB nearer (now ahead of TAAU), a panning thin scene 0.2 to 0.6 dB nearer and grass unchanged.
